people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Elizaphan
people.line: A Levite leader from the Kohathite clan.

people.name: Mishael
people.line: A Levite who helped remove the bodies of Nadab and Abihu.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

people.name: Uzziel
people.line: Son of Kohath, uncle of Moses and Aaron

translations.web: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, “Draw near, carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp.”
translations.bsb: Moses summoned Mishael and Elzaphan, sons of Aaron’s uncle Uzziel, and said to them, “Come here; carry the bodies of your cousins outside the camp, away from the front of the sanctuary.”
translations.kjv: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
translations.asv: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Draw near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
